test.command: python -m pytest -q tests/test_opportunity_controls.py tests/test_matched_performance.py; ruff check src/financial_brain/forward_edge/opportunity_controls.py tests/test_opportunity_controls.py

implemented: Matches on the same session within frozen size, liquidity-spread, and risk-budget relative calipers.
Uses deterministic no-replacement matching and reports matched net-return differences.
Retains every treated opportunity and explicit reasons for no contemporaneous control, caliper rejection, or exhausted controls.
States observational confounding and explicitly disclaims causal filter benefit and promotion inference.
blockers: Treated and no-trade/control outcomes and their matching attributes are caller-provided, not read from frozen paper books.
No authoritative registry binds the matching protocol and control outcomes.
The report is descriptive; real forward cohorts and dependence-aware inferential analysis remain necessary.
